items.title: Matas Buzelis hasn't been shy about how great he wants to be.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
Matas Buzelis hasn't been shy about how great he wants to be.

But have we confused his ambitions with evidence of his trajectory?

After two seasons, I see a very good complementary player more than a franchise centerpiece.

He's 21. There's plenty of time to show us otherwise.
